correctness.rationale: Haar difference is uniform on one Dirichlet cell. For every rank-two lattice the Gauss-reduced cell is a rectangle or cyclic hexagon. Exact disjoint circular-cap subtraction gives the CDF; each half-plane cap has a positive 3/2 onset at its strict sub-covering facet radius. Thus the CDF identifies area and all facet distances with multiplicities; rectangle basis norms or hexagonal Delaunay triangle SSS reconstruct the full lattice. Exact rational Gram checks, area/cyclic identities and independent angular quadratures support (but do not replace) the proof. Boundary and repeated-radii cases are included.

value.rationale: A metric-measure inverse theorem reconstructing all non-isometric Euclidean flat 2-tori from a single unlabeled pair-distance population law; it establishes exact formula, identifies all singular radii/multiplicities, and reconstructs an unmarked lattice including symmetric degeneracies. This resolves a natural geometry/tomography identification question and is not a routine substitution into a known forward moment formula.
